control_question: Does the AI feature use customer, personal, regulated or confidential data?
approved_source_artifact: Redacted AI feature inventory with data categories and excluded data classes
review_gate: Security and privacy owners approve before buyer answer is reused
revenue_risk: Enterprise security review asks for detail that sales cannot safely answer
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim no customer data, no personal data or no regulated data unless approved evidence supports the exact feature.

control_question: Which model, API, vendor or subprocessor supports the AI workflow?
approved_source_artifact: Vendor/model dependency register with owner, region, retention and training-use source links
review_gate: Vendor-risk owner approves any external answer or trust-centre wording
revenue_risk: Procurement blocks on AI vendor dependency, data processing or subprocessor questions
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim vendor approval, data residency, no training use or subprocessor coverage without current approved source evidence.

control_question: Who reviews, overrides or stops risky AI-assisted outputs?
approved_source_artifact: Human review and override matrix with triggers, fallback owner and escalation route
review_gate: Risk owner approves before production release or buyer-facing assurance wording
revenue_risk: Buyer doubts whether AI can create unreviewed customer impact
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim fully safe automation, guaranteed accuracy or no human review needed.

control_question: What logging proves control without exposing prompts or customer content?
approved_source_artifact: Masked event-log source map with retention owner, severity fields and evidence location
review_gate: Security owner approves redaction boundary before screenshots or logs are shared
revenue_risk: Security questionnaire asks for monitoring evidence, but raw logs would expose sensitive content
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not share prompts, customer content, secrets or production exports as proof.

control_question: Who approves prompt, policy, retrieval or model configuration changes?
approved_source_artifact: Change approval record linking request, reviewer, test evidence, release owner and rollback owner
review_gate: Release owner approves before deployment or buyer claim update
revenue_risk: Buyer asks how AI behavior changes are governed during an active deal
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim change management maturity, SOC 2 alignment or audit readiness without owner-approved evidence.

control_question: What happens if the AI vendor fails, price spikes or must be replaced?
approved_source_artifact: Exit and portability note with fallback workflow, cost-review trigger and customer-impact boundary
review_gate: Technical and finance owners approve before enterprise buyer answer
revenue_risk: Procurement flags lock-in, continuity, pricing or operational resilience risk
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not guarantee portability, uninterrupted service, cost stability or no vendor lock-in.

control_question: Which AI/security/compliance claims are approved for sales and trust centre reuse?
approved_source_artifact: Answer source map with approved wording, source artifact, expiry date and reviewer owner
review_gate: Reviewer signs off before external send, website update or RFP response
revenue_risk: Sales sends unsupported AI/security claims that create trust or legal friction
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not publish SOC 2 certified AI, compliant AI, secure by default, procurement approved or revenue-impact claims without approved source.

control_question: When must the evidence pack be refreshed?
approved_source_artifact: Renewal trigger list covering feature, vendor, data class, region, buyer question and pricing changes
review_gate: Quarterly or material-change review before reused answers are sent
revenue_risk: Old answers are reused after feature, model, region or buyer requirements changed
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not reuse stale evidence after material changes or expired owner approval.
